bio.text: Eric Mulder is the Libertarian Party nominee for governor of Colorado in 2026, on a joint ticket with Wayne Harlos for lieutenant governor.
He served in the U.S. Army from 2010 to 2016 and has worked as a security guard and small business owner.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Rocky Mountain College of Art + Design.
He ran for Colorado House District 36 in 2024 as a Forward Party candidate.
